description: One project approved in this meeting involves the development of an Artificial Intelligence-based, IoT-operated electronic wheelchair with helmet control, specifically designed to cater to differently-abled individuals.
body_lead: The 115th Executive Committee meeting of Uttar Pradesh Council of Science and Technology (UPCST) was convened, on October 5, under the chairmanship of Narendra Bhooshan, Principal Secretary of the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Uttar Pradesh, and Director-General of the Uttar Pradesh Council of Science and Technology (UPCST). During this meeting, approval was granted for a total of 109 research proposals, surpassing the number of research proposals approved in any previous year. The total expenditure for these research projects amounts to a substantial Rs 1,409 lakhs.
